headline: GPU rental prices held flat across all six GPUs over 7 days; MI300X leads price-performance.
bullets: Every tracked GPU posted a +0% 7-day change, with B200 indexed at $8.50, H200 at $5.40, and H100 SXM at $4.62.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, edging B200 at $3.78, though only 4 providers list MI300X.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +140%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 versus a neocloud median of $4.45.
Marketplaces remain the cheapest segment, with Vast.ai offering H100 SXM at $1.74 and A100 80GB SXM at $1.16.
A100 80GB SXM is the weakest value at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a low $2.70 market index.
watch: Watch whether the flat +0% run breaks first in B200, where the hyperscaler median of $14.12 sits well above the $8.50 index.
